title: BIP record
description: Facts about one BIP, copied from its spec header, plus BipWatch's own classification. One file per BIP at bips/<NNNN>/bip.yaml.

layer.description: Layer header from the spec. Absent in some older BIPs.

status_since.description: When the BIP took its current status: the date the Status header last moved to a different value on bitcoin/bips, else when the spec was added. Set by the header sync.

authors.description: Names only. Email addresses stay in the spec.

related.description: Companion or follow-up BIPs that build on this one.

spec.description: Where the canonical text lives and which revision this record was synced against.

bipwatch.description: BipWatch's own classification. Not part of the official BIP.

tracked.description: True for BIPs that get a full living page.

page.description: Which page the BIP gets: default (frame plus core and tracked modules), applications or consensus (adds that layer's modules). Default when absent. Set a layer page only once the data its modules read exists.

short_answer.description: Reviewed override for the hero's short answer. Without it, code writes one from needs.yaml.

aliases.description: Names the BIP goes by in discussion, used by the collectors' mention index. Only matched for tracked BIPs. Matched case-insensitively on word boundaries, so avoid common words.

watch.description: GitHub pull requests or issues outside bitcoin/bips whose discussion belongs to this BIP, such as an implementation in Bitcoin Core. The GitHub collector archives each one with its comments and reviews.
